items.title: 12.11 Zarron ke masses ke darmiyan forces ke nazariyat (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Mukhtalif wastoon (mediators) ke zariye zarron ke masses ke darmiyan taamulat ki wazahat ke liye do nazariyat hain: quantum field theory aur string theory.

Is nazariye ke mutabiq har zarra ek field se zahir hota hai jise quantum field kehte hain, aur yeh ek wasta ke zariye ek zarre se doosre tak force muntaqil karne ki zimmedar hai. Maslan musbat charged zarra apne gird space mein electric field banata hai, aur apni field ke zariye qareeb ke manfi charged zarre par kashish ki force lagata hai. Field ek zarre se doosre tak energy aur momentum bhi le ja sakti hai. Tamam fields ki energy aur momentum quantized hain; jo quanta ek zarre se doosre tak momentum aur energy ka tabadla karte hain woh field particles kehlate hain. Yun zarron ke taamulat field particles, ya quanta, ke tabadle se bayan hote hain, jo sab bosons hain. Electromagnetic force photons, electromagnetic field ke quanta, se; strong nuclear force gluons naami field particles se; weak force W aur Z bosons se; aur gravitational force gravitons naami field particles se chalti hai.

String theory nazariyati physics ka ek jadeed tasawwur hai jo kehta hai ke kaainat ke bunyadi zarre nuqte jaise hone ki bajaye asal mein nanhe larazte taar (strings) hain. Yeh strings khule ya band loops ho sakte hain, aur un ki larzish zarron ki khusoosiyat, mass aur force samet, tay karti hai. String theory ka dhancha, jo 'theory of everything' ka imkan deta hai, abhi tak tajrubati taur par sabit nahi hua.

blocks.prompt: Quantum field theory aur string theory ka mukhtasar muwazna kijiye.
blocks.explanation: Quantum field theory har zarre ko kisi field ka quantum samajhti hai aur forces ko boson field particles (photons, gluons, W aur Z, gravitons) ke tabadle se bayan karti hai; yeh Standard Model ki bunyad hai aur achi tarah parkhi gayi hai. String theory nuqta-numa zarron ki jagah nanhe larazte khule ya band strings rakhti hai jin ki larzish ke andaaz zarron ke masses aur forces dete hain; yeh gravity samet 'theory of everything' banna chahti hai magar tajrube se tasdeeq nahi hui.

items: Quantum field theory: har zarre ki quantum field; forces field quanta ka tabadla, sab bosons: photons (electromagnetic), gluons (strong), W aur Z (weak), gravitons (gravity).

String theory: zarre nanhe larazte khule ya band strings jin ki larzish mass aur force tay karti hai; 'theory of everything' ka umeedwar, abhi sabit nahi. Paimana: molecule 10^-9 m se quark 10^-18 m se kam tak.
